text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara pulled off a splendid run and 
left her mark on the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

And as for Haru Urara, having reached such 
a major milestone...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho, heave-ho... Phew~, I 
worked hard!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks! Running really does feel so 
good!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Running in lots of races was so, so much 
fun for me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I wondered, "Why is that?" and then I 
realized: "It's because I'm running!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep running in lots of races! 
And take 1st place, of course!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I want you to always cheer me on, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I'll keep on running, and Trainer will 
keep on cheering! Sounds fun, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, please keep watching over me 
from now on too, Trainer!
